newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia shoe thrower jailed for court contempt.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia shoe thrower jailed for court contempt.

text.p: An Indonesian student has been sentenced to five months in jail for throwing his shoe at a judge, the Jakarta Post newspaper said on Thursday.

Ignatius Pujianto, an interior design student, threw his shoe at Central Jakarta District Court Judge Syoffinan to protest the sentencing earlier this year of controversial opposition politician Sri Bintang Pamungkas to 34 months in jail.
The shoe missed the target, but Ignatius was taken into custody.
"I will continue my struggle against unfair judges," Ignatius told reporters after Wednesday's verdict, resplendent in a new pair of black shoes.
He said he lost one of his old pair of brown shoes when the court ordered the destruction of all evidence in the contempt-of-court case filed against him.
